Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: It misinterpreted the request “the 2019 game that won the British Academy Games Awards” as the winner of the 2019 ceremony (God of War, a 2018 release) rather than a game released in 2019 that won (e.g., Outer Wilds). This wrong target led the process down the incorrect page, ignored the “as of the most recent entry from 2022” constraint and the “before the month” nuance, and ultimately produced an unsupported final count.
